title: CMake: Remove Qt5 build support
description:
Remove support for building with Qt 5. Qt 5 has been end of life
from the Qt Company since May 2025, even for with paid commercial
support licenses, and imposes a significant development burden on
new features. There is a collection of patches for Qt 5 for
open-source distributions, which can be used for building 4.6.x
and earlier.

Removing all the QT_VERSION_CHECK guarded code (outside of
third-party code like QCustomPlot) will come in another commit.

AI-Assisted: no

notes.body: I would have written more ;-) But more importantly, should we note this in stratoshark release notes as well?
We could add it to Stratoshark, but I feel that's less important since there hasn't been a 1.0 release of Stratoshark yet.
@johnthacker - Are you now working on the QT_VERSION_CHECK removal?  I did start working on this a while back, if you haven't already started (with latest master).  I can revive my old branch.
I have not started yet, I also have an old branch with conflicts with the current master that I would need to resolve or start over. If you want to go ahead, feel free.
